result.summary: The environment provides continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of a residential street, ensuring basic pedestrian connectivity. However, the wide, unmarked roadway lacks traffic calming, designated crossings, and physical buffers, which may compromise pedestrian safety and comfort.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide, unmarked roadway without designated right-of-way or visibility enhancements.

hazards.name: Absence of lane markings
hazards.description: The lack of defined travel lanes can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and potentially higher speeds.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark crossings with high-visibility patterns to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at intersections or mid-block to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning traffic.

interventions.title: Street trees and buffers
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a safety buffer from moving vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a modern multi-story building with a wide, well-maintained concrete sidewalk. However, the adjacent roadway is in a state of severe disrepair, appearing as an unpaved or heavily degraded dirt and gravel surface without any clear lane markings or traffic organization.

hazards.name: Severe Roadway Degradation
hazards.description: The roadway surface is completely broken or unpaved, creating uneven terrain and potential for vehicle instability near the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, across the entire width of the visible roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Delineation
hazards.description: Absence of lane markings or parking stalls on a wide, degraded surface may lead to unpredictable vehicle movements and encroachment on the pedestrian realm.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway area in front of the building.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Pave the roadway with asphalt to provide a predictable, stable surface for vehicles and reduce debris.

interventions.title: Pavement Markings
interventions.description: Install clear lane lines and parking stall markings to organize traffic flow and define the roadway edge.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Add a furniture zone with trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with sidewalks but lacking marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite the presence of traffic lights. The roadway is unmarked and shows signs of wear, while utility poles create minor obstructions on the pedestrian walkway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, making pedestrian crossing points unclear to drivers at a signalized junction.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the intersection

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are positioned within the sidewalk area, narrowing the effective clear width for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve safety and predictability for people crossing.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Road Diet
interventions.description: Add center lines and lane markings to organize traffic flow and discourage speeding on the wide, unmarked roadway.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, well-maintained concrete sidewalk directly adjacent to a residential building. While the walkway is clear and continuous, there is a lack of physical buffering from the roadway and no visible street lighting or greenery along the path.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian-vehicle separation
hazards.description: There is no physical buffer, such as a planting strip or parked cars, between the wide sidewalk and the roadway edge.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the bottom edge of the sidewalk where it meets the road

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone with street trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during evening and night hours.
